purpose: Repair the two pre-Actor/runtime blockers demonstrated by R1, then rerun the same authorized 12-task development validation without changing its scoring or task set.

registered_repairs.defect: A structurally parseable response that fails SupervisorPlan local invariants exhausts the controller-level resume instead of giving the same Coordinator the exact validation error.
registered_repairs.repair: Use the existing bounded semantic-repair budget to request one fresh complete canonical plan from the same Coordinator; do not map or synthesize alternate response fields in the Controller.
registered_repairs.regression_test: First response fails SupervisorPlan validation, second canonical response succeeds, and the second request contains the exact local validation error.

registered_repairs.defect: A failed list_directory/search_text action has no structured success payload, but the projection layer still JSON-parses it and aborts the run.
registered_repairs.repair: Project failed structured-page actions as ordinary bounded failure observations so the same RWKV Actor receives the Harness error and can choose the next action.
registered_repairs.regression_test: list_directory on a file remains a failed action observation and does not raise ObservationProjectionError.
